test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

He says that he will clear all his dues by the following month.

options.text: He said, “ I will clear all my dues by next month.”
He said, “ I would clear all my dues by next month.”
He says, “ I will clear all my dues by next month.”
He says, “ I will clear all his dues by next month.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the verb tense is in the** present,** and the **pronoun usage needs to be consistent with the subject.**
 
• The sentence is in **direct speech**, so it should reflect the exact words spoken by the subject.
 
• The correct direct form retains the future tense "**will"** and the pronoun **"my" **to align with the subject **"he".**
 
• Format =** Reported verb, + "Reported speech'.**

Therefore, the correct direct form of this narration is **'He says, “I will clear all my dues by next month.”**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are incorrect as they don't match with the correct format of direct speech.
